BLS EP 39-2021: from 365,300 in 2025 to 409,400 in 2035, an official net increase of 44,100; growth of 12.1% over 2025—2035 (OOH rounds this to 12%), with an annual average of 62,800 openings including growth and replacement, and the self-employed accounting for 24.8%. The 39-2000 combined group, 413000/11.2%/an annual average of 69400, does not substitute for it.

entries.answer: In the O*NET survey, 87% work indoors in a controlled environment every day, 98% have a regular schedule, 56% work 40 hours and 37% fewer than 40, 56% are outdoors every day, 78% are exposed to noise, 63% to contaminants, 45% to infection and 58% to minor injuries, 56% stand continually and 93% have face-to-face contact every day; these are not everyone's conditions, an accident rate or an individual prediction, and a regular schedule is not the same as working only weekdays.
